# W0501: catch-all without a reason

An arm that drops every error hides failures. Raise the error again, use it, or say why dropping it is right, as `catch _ because "…" => …`.

- Rule: [`effects.catch-alls-need-reason`](../../reference/12-effects.md#effects.catch-alls-need-reason)
- Reported at: the arm's pattern.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `warnings` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt W0501:5
type ParseError = | Empty

fn parse(text: str) -> i64 / raise<ParseError> { raise Empty }

fn count(text: str) -> i64 { try parse(text) catch _ => 0 }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type ParseError = | Empty

fn parse(text: str) -> i64 / raise<ParseError> { raise Empty }

fn count(text: str) -> i64 { try parse(text) catch _ because "an empty line counts zero" => 0 }
```
